mari_reply.name: Mari's Reply
mari_reply.text: Folded once. On the outside, in flour-dusted pencil: THEO. Inside, three words, and a letter M.

ferry_ticket.name: One-Way Ferry Ticket
ferry_ticket.text: MORNING LARK · ONE WAY · 15 OCT · 6:10. June's ticket. "Hold onto this for me."

lighthouse_key.name: Lighthouse Key
lighthouse_key.text: Heavy brass, warm from Tobias's pocket. Opens the door at the foot of the Hushwater Light. 112 steps to the lamp.

paper_lantern.name: Paper Lantern
paper_lantern.text: Odile's gift for Lantern Night. For someone you've lost — or someone you will.
